title: Publish exhaustive portfolio ranking into living report
description:
A production-shaped read-only portfolio run completed exhaustive ranking but failed while publishing the ranking milestone into its living Report. Preserve the fatal-publication rule while making the full ranked packet publishable.

Feature: Durable ranking milestone

Scenario: Publish a large exhaustive rank packet
Given an account-wide rank packet contains hundreds of score rows and complete coverage
When the portfolio runner publishes the ranking milestone
Then the living Report receives a reconciled evidence revision and workbook
And the run continues into deterministic assessment

Scenario: Expose the underlying publication cause
Given ranking publication fails
When the portfolio runner records the failure
Then the durable failure evidence includes the underlying cause
And the workflow remains failed closed

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Root cause reproduced with a failing outside-in test: the stakeholder projection added Rank to all score rows, but the workbook allowlist permitted Rank only on two sheets, so deterministic validation rejected the first feedback-investment row. Rank is now an explicit column on every score-level sheet and optimization outcomes retain their one-based rank. Evidence: 53 focused portfolio/report tests pass.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Board audit 2026-10-17: verified against develop. Rank is an explicit column on every score-level workbook sheet so the ranking milestone validates, and core publication failures remain fatal while recording the operation and underlying exception class. Covered by run_report_test core-publication-failure and large-portfolio tests and the portfolio_run_test workbook projection tests.
